minor_noble.name: Child of a Small Noble House
minor_noble.desc: A name that opens doors, but not very wide.

merchant_ward.name: Raised by a Merchant Family
merchant_ward.desc: Money you did not earn and manners you had to learn.

veteran_officer.name: Disgraced Officer
veteran_officer.desc: The soldiers remember you. The court would rather forget you.

archivist.name: Record Keeper's Helper
archivist.desc: You have read what others only whisper. You already know one secret goal.

returned_exile.name: Exile Who Came Back
returned_exile.desc: You know how courts fall. You have nobody to lean on. You already know one secret goal.

grey_pawn.name: The Patron's Pawn
grey_pawn.desc: Someone arranged your arrival, and she expects you to pay her back.
grey_pawn.unlock: Find the Veiled Patron in any reign.

pressures.tyranny: You hold on so tight that the court has started to flinch.
pressures.envy_fame: Everyone is talking about you, and not all of it is kind.
pressures.entitlement: Your followers now expect more than you can give.
pressures.envy_wealth: Your money gets more attention than your advice.
pressures.weakness: People answer your orders with polite delay.
pressures.disrepute: Talk stops when you walk into a room.
pressures.desertion: There are empty chairs where your friends used to sit.
pressures.penury: People you owe have started to smile at you.

guile.label: Trickery
guile.blurb: You like to mislead, use pressure and let other people do your work.

force.label: Force
force.blurb: You settle things by making it costly to oppose you.

charm.label: Charm
charm.blurb: You win rooms with gifts, shows and careful handling of praise.

restraint.label: Patience
restraint.blurb: You wait, hold back and let others go too far before you move.

candour.label: Honesty
candour.blurb: You tell people where they stand and accept what follows.

pragmatism.label: Deal-making
pragmatism.blurb: To you every friendship is a ledger, and you read it well.

meters.authority: How much people obey your orders.
meters.reputation: How the court and the people see you.
meters.loyalty: Who will stand with you when it counts.
meters.resources: Money, favours and the means to get things done.
